questions.question: On this day in 1602, which historic research library at the University of Oxford first opened its doors to readers?
questions.explanation: Established by Sir Thomas Bodley, the Bodleian Library at Oxford was officially opened to the public on this day in 1602.
questions.context:
On this day in 1602: The Bodleian Library at the University of Oxford is opened to the public.
Bodleian Library (Research library of the University of Oxford): The Bodleian Library is the main research library of the University of Oxford. Founded in 1602 by Sir Thomas Bodley, it is one of the oldest libraries in Europe. With over 13 million printed items, it is the second-largest library in Britain after the British Library.

questions.question: In which 2007 British comedy film did Russell Brand take on his first prominent movie acting role?
questions.explanation: Brand landed his initial major film appearance in the 2007 UK comedy St Trinian's before starring in several Hollywood features.
questions.context: Russell Brand (English comedian and actor (born 1975)): Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor and media personality. He rose to prominence as the host of Big Brother's Big Mouth, a spin-off of the reality television series Big Brother broadcast on E4. He had his first major film role in the British comedy St Trinian's (2007), after which he starred in the Hollywood comedies Forgetting Sarah Marshall (2008), Get Him to the Greek (2010), Arthur (2011), and Rock of Ages (2012), as well as the mystery film Death on the Nile (2022).

questions.question: Due to her distinct visual style and music influence, what royal moniker did Vogue and Rolling Stone bestow upon pop star Katy Perry?
questions.explanation: Katy Perry earned the title 'Queen of Camp' from major publications such as Rolling Stone and Vogue.
questions.context: Katy Perry (American singer (born 1984)): Katheryn Elizabeth Hudson, known professionally as Katy Perry, is an American singer, songwriter, and television personality. Known for her influence on pop music and her camp style, she has been dubbed the "Queen of Camp" by Vogue and Rolling Stone.

questions.question: For which German football club did midfielder and forward Jobe Bellingham sign to play in the Bundesliga?
questions.explanation: Jobe Bellingham plays professionally as a midfielder or forward in Germany for Borussia Dortmund.
questions.context: Jobe Bellingham (English footballer (born 2005)): Jobe Samuel Patrick Bellingham is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or forward for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the England national team. He has represented England at all youth levels and served as the under-21 captain from 2024 to 2026.

questions.question: On which Caribbean island did eighteen-year-old student Natalee Holloway vanish while travelling in May 2005?
questions.explanation: Natalee Holloway went missing in May 2005 during a high-school graduation holiday in Aruba.
questions.context: Disappearance of Natalee Holloway (2005 disappearance of an American in Aruba): On May 30, 2005, Natalee Ann Holloway, an 18‑year‑old recent high school graduate from Mountain Brook, Alabama, disappeared while on a trip to Aruba. She was last seen outside the Oranjestad nightclub Carlos'n Charlie's, entering a car with Joran van der Sloot and brothers Deepak and Satish Kalpoe. Despite extensive searches involving Aruban authorities, FBI agents, Dutch military personnel, and volunteer teams, her remains have never been found.
